sources: https://www.camplife.com/399/reservation/step1 (CampLife booking API: reservation session, park record and site records for campground 399, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Storm closure: 'Notice of Temporary Closure. This recreation site is temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts.' (posted during Hurricane Isaias, October 2026). No reopening date posted; the District's Recreation Site Closures page does not list this site.

status.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/apalachicola-river/florida-river-island/ ('Notice of Temporary Closure. This recreation site is temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Free permit booked through the District's CampLife reservation system (a free account is needed, and availability shows only once logged in). Up to 7 nights per reservation; no more than two reservations at a time or in a 30-day period. Each site holds up to eight people and two vehicles.

booking.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/apalachicola-river/florida-river-island/ ('10 overnight campsites that are available by reservation only', 'Each campsite can hold a maximum of eight people and two vehicles') + https://nwfwater.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Step-by-Step-Instructions-on-How-to-Make-A-Camping-Reservation.pdf ('A reservation can be made for up to seven (7) nights'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/apalachicola-river/florida-river-island/ ('The campsites do not have power, water or waste disposal hookups.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 7-10 take all camping equipment including RVs, trailers and vans (CampLife: back-in, motorhomes accepted); 1-6 are tent-only. CampLife lists the RV sites as 50 x 50 ft, which looks like a default rather than a measured length, so no max rig length is recorded.

sites.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/apalachicola-river/florida-river-island/ ('Campsites 1 through 6 are for use by campers with tents only, while campsites 7 through 10 may be used by campers with all types of camping equipment, including RVs, trailers and vans.') + CampLife session for campground 399 (site type 'Back-in' with MOTORHOME among its equipment), read 2026-10-21

values.note: One composting toilet; two picnic pavilions, pedestal grills, fire rings, boat ramp.

facilities.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/apalachicola-river/florida-river-island/ ('This recreation area offers two picnic pavilions, pedestal grills, fire rings and a composting toilet.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Northwest Florida Water Management District recreation area at the east end of the Florida River bridge on the Apalachicola River floodplain near Bristol (Forest Road 188 off FL-379). The bridge gate closes during and after high water (pedestrian access only then). Site length is not published - primitive sites on unpaved access; check the site diagram before bringing a big rig. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the District page and CampLife: 10 reservation-only sites (7-10 for RVs, motorhomes accepted), no hookups, composting toilet, 7-night limit, free. Added a temporary storm closure (site-page banner, October 2026). Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: max rig length, season, potable water.
flags: Temporary storm closure recorded from the District's site-page banner ('temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts', Hurricane Isaias, October 2026); the District's own Recreation Site Closures list does not include Florida River Island, so the two pages disagree. Needs a re-check soon.
